SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS history_id , sys01_company_id AS company_id , sys01_company_nm AS company_nm , sys01_loc_nm AS loc_nm , a.total_count AS total_count , ( SELECT count(sms02_history_id) FROM sms02_history WHERE sms02_company_id = a.sms02_company_id ) AS running_total_count FROM ( SELECT sms02_company_id , count(*) AS total_count FROM sms02_history GROUP BY sms02_company_id ) a INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sms02_company_id
AND ((#{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'true') = 'true') OR (#{useYn} = 'false'))
ORDER BY a.total_count DESC, sys01_company_nm

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS history_id , a.year AS year , a.total_count AS total_count , a.total_pay_count AS total_pay_count FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(sms02_send_date, 'yyyy') AS year , count(sms02_send_date) AS total_count , (count(sms02_send_date) * 9.5) AS total_pay_count FROM sms02_history INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sms02_company_id AND sys01_loc_nm = #{locName} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sms02_send_date, 'yyyy') ) a ORDER BY a.year DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS history_id , a.month AS month , a.total_count AS total_count , a.total_pay_count AS total_pay_count FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(sms02_send_date, 'mm') AS month , count(sms02_send_date) AS total_count , (count(sms02_send_date) * 9.5) AS total_pay_count FROM sms02_history INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sms02_company_id AND sys01_loc_nm = #{locName} WHERE TO_CHAR(sms02_send_date, 'yyyy') = #{year} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sms02_send_date, 'mm') ) a ORDER BY a.month DESC
